matchmaking_summary: The candidate has extensive experience in .NET development, specializing in front-end technologies such as ASP.Net, C#, JavaScript, and jQuery. They have worked on multiple projects involving data retrieval and manipulation with ADO.Net, Entity Framework, and LINQ queries. Their role required them to be involved in the entire software development lifecycle, collaborating closely with team members and stakeholders to ensure high-quality code and timely delivery of solutions.
